title.en: Keep Diesel 120 Concrete Pump as printed while Flange only supplies the map

description.en: The Diesel 120 Concrete Pump note follows the outline of Flange. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Diesel 120 Concrete Pump. The published table prints Engine Power (Diesel) 290 kW (two units 145 kW); Theoretical Output 100 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 40 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³; Conveying Distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112 (two units); Max. Aggregate Size 6 cm and below; Dimensions (L×W×H) 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm; Main Unit Weight 8000 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 柴油120型混凝土泵这篇笔记顺着《法兰》的大纲写。邢台河北品锦机械公布柴油120型混凝土泵。已公布参数表印有：柴油机功率290 kW (two units 145 kW)；理论输送量100 m³/h；最大出口压力40 MPa；料斗容积0.6 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直）150 m / 500 m；液压泵Kawasaki 112 (two units)；最大骨料粒径6 cm and below；外形尺寸7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm；整机重量8000 kg。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
